en.headline: 2 own commits plus 21 automated commits and 2 issue actions
en.summary: The day included **2 own commits** plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/myBlog`, the author added a screenshot showing the OpenChamber session retention hint. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, documentation was updated with the VS Code harness and the on-disk location for disabling AI features, and the Profile conclusion was corrected. The author opened or closed **2 issues**: they opened `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5680, “[Bug] Session retention hint still describes the old "Only archived sessions" checkbox,” and commented on `anomalyco/opencode` issue #55772, “[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it.” A reply to issue #5680 from `openchamber-bot[bot]` confirmed the reported hint string and traced the cause, marking it `fix-ready`.

zh.headline: 2 次本人提交，另有 21 次自动提交，并处理 2 个 issue
zh.summary: 当天共有 **2 次本人提交**，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/myBlog` 中，作者添加了展示 OpenChamber 会话保留提示的截图。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，文档补充了 VS Code harness 及关闭 AI 功能的落盘位置，并更正了 Profile 结论。作者新开或关闭了 **2 个 issue**：新开 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #5680“[Bug] Session retention hint still describes the old "Only archived sessions" checkbox”，并在 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 #55772“[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it”中发表评论。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复 issue #5680，确认了所报告的提示文本并追踪到原因，将其标记为 `fix-ready`。
